actions.script: (()=>{const n=new Set([...document.querySelectorAll(`a.card-title[href*=\"/jobs/\"]`)].map(a=>a.href)).size;const h=[...document.querySelectorAll(`h1,h2,h3,h4`)].map(e=>(e.textContent||``).trim().replace(/\s+/g,` `)).find(t=>/^\d+ Ofertas de empleo$/i.test(t));if(!h)throw new Error(`missing advertised job total`);const e=Number(h.match(/^\d+/)[0]);if(n!==e)throw new Error(`found ${n} unique jobs but page advertises ${e}`);return n})()

(()=>{const m=document.querySelector(`.col-md-8.p-4.px-md-5.wp-block-bootstrap-column`),b=document.querySelector(`.block-body.has-primary-color.has-gray-200-background-color`);if(!m||!b)throw new Error(`missing job content or metadata`);const x=(b.innerText||``).split(/\n+/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean),d=x.find(s=>/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/.test(s)),l=x.filter(s=>s!==d&&!/^(?:[A-Z]{2}\d+|\d+)$/.test(s)).join(`, `);if(!d)throw new Error(`missing job date`);const de=document.createElement(`p`);de.dataset.wsDate=``;de.textContent=d;m.appendChild(de);if(l){const le=document.createElement(`p`);le.dataset.wsLocation=``;le.textContent=l;m.appendChild(le)}})()
